business_summary: Integral Group Corporation is a private equity firm which specializes in management buyouts, turnaround, leveraged buyouts, mezzanine, and other minority investments. The firm seeks to invest in both listed and unlisted mid-cap companies based in Japan. It does not have a specific list of industries to which it prefers to invest in. The firm is also into management and financial consulting related to equity investment activities. The company was formerly known as Integral Corporation and changed its name to Integral Group Corporation in October 2026. Integral Group Corporation was established on September 1, 2007 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.
